# place superseded by

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:placeSupersededBy`](gmeow-placeSupersededBy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/placeSupersededBy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Links a place to the place that replaced it — Constantinople [`placeSupersededBy`](gmeow-placeSupersededBy.md) Istanbul, a merged municipality [`placeSupersededBy`](gmeow-placeSupersededBy.md) its successor. Directional. The superseded place is retained (never deleted) and may carry [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link a place to the place that replaced it (renaming, merger); directional, a subproperty of [`gmeow:supersededBy`](gmeow-supersededBy.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid deleting the superseded place — retain it, optionally with [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)); avoid using it for a mere alternate name (that is a [`PlaceName`](../classes/gmeow-PlaceName.md) via the names slice).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:placeSupersededBy`](gmeow-placeSupersededBy.md) from the old place to the new; read the inverse via [`gmeow:placeSupersedes`](gmeow-placeSupersedes.md).

### Examples

- ex:constantinople [`gmeow:placeSupersededBy`](gmeow-placeSupersededBy.md) ex:istanbul.
